answer.justification: Type II pneumocytes are surfactant-secreting alveolar progenitor cells that proliferate after injury and differentiate to replace damaged type I cells, restoring the alveolar lining. Ciliated cells, goblet cells, and club cells are airway structures and do not regenerate alveolar epithelium.
